hosts.statement: vantage.insta.host is served publicly with NO identity gate from 1.1.0. Every SPA client route, every content-hashed static asset, the health and readiness endpoints and the public Trust Center API answer 200 to an anonymous request, while every authenticated API path answers 401. The negative control is the same hostname minutes earlier: before the Access application was deleted, /api/public/config returned the Cloudflare Access sign-in page instead of JSON, which is what the ungate verifier used to prove it could fail.

artifacts.name: SPA application bundle
artifacts.cache_justification: Vite emits content-hashed filenames referenced from index.html, so the published name changes whenever the bytes change and no purge is required. This release changed the bundle from index-BTsh00Jb.js to index-aXtiTyVG.js, and the superseded name is no longer referenced by index.html. Assets under /assets/ are served immutable; index.html itself carries a short max-age.
artifacts.verification_command: curl -s https://vantage.insta.host/ | grep -oE '/assets/index-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.js' | head -1 | xargs -I{} curl -sI https://vantage.insta.host{}
